key.name: panel-items
key.summary: Values pinned to the top bar, in order (row ids from the popup: cpu.usage, net.down, fan.dell-smm-processor-fan, ...)

key.name: hide-zeros
key.summary: Leave out readings that are zero (idle fans, no traffic) in the popup and the top bar

key.name: section-rows
key.summary: Rows an open section of the popup shows before it scrolls (6 is Compact, 12 is Tall in Settings)

key.name: interval-ac
key.summary: Seconds between updates on AC power

key.name: interval-saver
key.summary: In power saver nothing is shown; seconds between the memory checks that still run

key.name: auto-saver-percent
key.summary: On battery, switch to power saver at or below this charge (0 = never); back to the previous mode when plugged in

key.name: auto-saver-from
key.summary: The mode the low-battery rule switched away from (internal)

key.name: memory-warning
key.summary: Warn once when memory and swap are 85 % full, naming the app using the most

key.name: saver-desktop
key.summary: In power saver, also dim the screen sooner

key.name: saved-desktop
key.summary: Desktop settings from before power saver, put back when it ends (internal)

key.name: panel-box
key.summary: Top bar section for the readouts
